text: Tonight, same guy came back in against the crowd. Bag, cable cutter. Went down the riser. Hasn't come up.
style: A facility guard in his mid-thirties, six months into taking money he has stopped being able to explain. Consistent working-class American accent, Pacific Northwest, throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Low, flat pitch; slow, too-casual pace. Talks like a man rehearsing an answer he has already given himself.
